title: Location-only text in public search autocomplete

requirements.summary: Ensure Location autocomplete suggestions display and populate location text only (no property titles).
acceptanceCriteria: Typing in the public search Location field shows autocomplete suggestions that are locations only (no property titles appear in the dropdown).
Selecting an autocomplete suggestion populates the Location input with that location text exactly (no title prefix/suffix).

Backend method `getBackendAutocompleteSuggestions(input, maxResults)` only searches/matches against stored `property.location` values (not `property.title`) while keeping case-insensitive matching, de-duplication, and `maxResults` limiting behavior.
Update any frontend comments/docs that claim the autocomplete searches titles so they accurately reflect location-only behavior.

file_operations.description: Update hook docs/comments to reflect location-only behavior (remove any mention of searching titles). Add a small client-side normalization step so the hook returns location text only (e.g., strip any title/location combined formatting if present), then de-duplicate results while preserving order.

Update the backend-autocomplete hook comment/docs to remove claims that it searches property titles and to accurately describe location-only suggestions behavior. Keep the existing debouncing and query caching behavior intact.

Ensure the Location autocomplete dropdown renders only the location suggestion text returned by the location-suggestions hook (no additional title/label rendering). Confirm selection writes the suggestion string into the Location input exactly as displayed.
